summary: The belt strengthens the secret boundary: refused (secret-shaped/oversized) context files now block the commit itself instead of failing later in CI, and refused files are never registered in the ledger. Deny messages carry only file names and detector labels (line N + class), never matched secret values. The git add is fixed-argv with cwd=root and '--' separator, no shell; the index mutation is bounded to exactly docs/context/ledger.json and only after a successful scan. Belt detection resists -C/--git-dir, env-var prefixes, absolute git paths, and compound commands.

non_blocking_findings.summary: A commit inside a subshell '(git commit)' evades has_git_commit; an agent has no reason to write that shape, and the unchanged CI freshness check plus context scan's own refusal on the next explicit scan remain the backstop.

residual_risks: Out-of-session commits see no hooks by design (decision 0035); CI's context scan --check is the recorded backstop.
git commit <pathspec> bypasses the index so the staged ledger does not ride that commit (decision 0035, accepted).
